title: great app, but needs a ‘scan another qr code’ feature badly
body: my alarms haven’t been ringing lately, the “current device” setting seems to have fixed it so i appreciate that feature as i sleep with earphones on. i’ve been using the app for years now, primarily the QR code feature, and today was the first time i actually had to delete the app to turn off my alarm. i usually scan the qr code on my toothpaste to get myself out of my bedroom but the old toothpaste had been thrown out. usually i power off my phone for three hours and the alarm dismisses itself, but today i need my phone. i think an option for “scan another qr code” would solve this issue, particularly for people who are not staying in the same house on the same days every week. even if this option only shows up after x amount of time. it’s a great app, definitely saved me a few times in college, but the lack of emergency backup in this case is becoming a bit infuriating.
